Plan your whole week in 10 minutes tonight. 🗓️

1. Look 14 days out and find the big one hiding next week.
2. Split it into dated steps and start step 1 this week.
3. Put practice quizzes in the calendar, not "review notes".
4. Leave one evening empty on purpose.

Save this for Sunday night. What's the big one on your next two weeks? 👇
